items.text: Both the capture FAB (`floating-action-button.tsx` z-30) and the sidebar container (`Sidebar.tsx` z-30) share the same z-index. The FAB renders later in the DOM so it visually floats above the sidebar. The mobile backdrop is z-20, sidebar is z-30, capture panel is z-40, and detail overlays are z-40/z-50.

The FAB already adjusts its `right` position when the sidebar is open on desktop (`md:right-[21.5rem]`), but does not hide itself or lower its z-index. On mobile, the sidebar goes full-width with a z-20 backdrop + z-30 sidebar, so the FAB (also z-30) peeks through.

items.context: The capture FAB and sidebar both use z-30. We need the sidebar to cover the FAB when open. There are two clean approaches that don't disrupt the rest of the z-index hierarchy.

options.label: Lower the FAB to z-20
options.rationale: Move the FAB from z-30 to z-20. Since the sidebar is z-30, it will naturally cover the FAB. The HUD bar is also z-20 but they don't overlap spatially. This is the minimal change.

options.label: Raise the sidebar to z-40
options.rationale: Keep FAB at z-30 and bump sidebar to z-40. Downside: the sidebar would share z-40 with the capture panel (FloatingPanel), which could cause new stacking issues when the capture panel is open alongside the sidebar.

options.label: Conditionally hide the FAB when sidebar is open
options.rationale: Instead of z-index changes, hide the FAB entirely when the sidebar is open. Simplest visually but reduces discoverability — users won't see the capture button until they close the sidebar.

items.context: The FAB is currently at `bottom: calc(5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` (about 80px from the bottom). The description says it appears 'too high on the page'. Need to determine the target position.

options.label: Move to bottom-4 (1rem / 16px from bottom edge)
options.rationale: Standard Material Design FAB position. Very close to the bottom — might be too close on mobile with gesture navigation areas.

options.label: Move to bottom-6 (1.5rem / 24px from bottom edge)
options.rationale: Slightly above the very bottom, good balance between visibility and not interfering with mobile gestures. Keeps safe-area-inset for mobile.

options.label: Keep current bottom calc but reduce the 5rem to 3rem
options.rationale: Preserves the safe-area-inset-bottom pattern but moves button lower. Results in about 48px + safe area from bottom.

plan_updates: Created initial plan.md with problem statement, root cause analysis, current z-index hierarchy, scope, acceptance criteria, and testing strategy. Implementation approach TBD pending decisions on fix strategy and button position.
